## `standalone_names`

**F1:** 0.012 | **Precision:** 0.018 | **Recall:** 0.009  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `f6d24073`  
**Description:**
Captures names at the start of sentences or after punctuation, strictly requiring a second name part or specific context to avoid matching headers.

**Content:**
```

## `simple_names_in_context`

**F1:** 0.014 | **Precision:** 0.014 | **Recall:** 0.014  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `c5a28dd1`  
**Description:**
Captures simple names appearing in legal contexts like 'durch', 'von', 'des', 'der', 'als', 'gegen' without specific titles, ensuring no trailing conjunctions and full name capture including hyphenated names.

**Content:**
```
(?:durch|von|des|der|als|gegen|in\s+der|im|zu|nach|vor|für|bei|unter|über|aus|an|auf|mit|wegen|wegen\s+des)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+|\-[A-Z][a-z]+)+)(?![\s]+(?:als|und|oder|sowie|in|der|des|die|den|von|mit|auf|an|bei|zu|f\u00fcr|nach|vor|\u00fcber|unter|neben|zwischen|durch|ohne|gegen|bis|seit|w\u00e4hrend|trotz|wegen|statt|au\u00dfer|um|als|und|oder|sowie|\.|,|;|:|\)))

## `simple_names_in_context`

**F1:** 0.014 | **Precision:** 0.014 | **Recall:** 0.014  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `c5a28dd1`  
**Description:**
Captures simple names appearing in legal contexts like 'durch', 'von', 'des', 'der', 'als', 'gegen' without specific titles, ensuring no trailing conjunctions and full name capture including hyphenated names.

**Content:**
```
(?:durch|von|des|der|als|gegen|in\s+der|im|zu|nach|vor|für|bei|unter|über|aus|an|auf|mit|wegen|wegen\s+des)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+|\-[A-Z][a-z]+)+)(?![\s]+(?:als|und|oder|sowie|in|der|des|die|den|von|mit|auf|an|bei|zu|f\u00fcr|nach|vor|\u00fcber|unter|neben|zwischen|durch|ohne|gegen|bis|seit|w\u00e4hrend|trotz|wegen|statt|au\u00dfer|um|als|und|oder|sowie|\.|,|;|:|\)))
```

## `standalone_names`

**F1:** 0.012 | **Precision:** 0.018 | **Recall:** 0.009  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `f6d24073`  
**Description:**
Captures names at the start of sentences or after punctuation, strictly requiring a second name part or specific context to avoid matching headers.
